founder.name: Aryan Mittal
founder.title: Founder, Marmilix
founder.headline: WE DON'T JUST PROVIDE STONE — WE CREATE EXPERIENCES
founder.story: Marmilix was built on a simple belief: natural stone is more than a material—it's a story. Our collections reflect precision, sustainability, and artistry. With every marble slab, granite finish, and custom stone solution, we aim to deliver depth, character, and a lasting impression. Our mission is to bring India's finest stones to the world through trust, innovation, and craftsmanship.

mission.title: Our Mission
mission.text: To deliver premium, ethically sourced marble and granite products that enhance modern spaces. We aim to blend quality, sustainability, and innovation to redefine natural stone experiences around the world.

vision.title: Our Vision
vision.text: To become a globally admired Indian stone brand known for premium marble, granite, and custom stone artistry—while staying rooted in heritage craftsmanship and modern innovation.

pillars.title: Premium Quality Marble & Granite
pillars.description: Every Marmilix stone product—whether marble, granite, or custom natural stone—is sourced with precision, ensuring durability, elegance, and world-class quality.

pillars.title: Sustainable Stone Processing
pillars.description: We combine modern stone-cutting technology with eco-friendly practices, delivering natural stone products that are both timeless and sustainable.

pillars.title: Customer-Centric Approach
pillars.description: We prioritize transparency, trust, and unmatched service to ensure our clients—from homeowners to global importers—experience excellence at every step.

pillars.title: Heritage Meets Modern Craftsmanship
pillars.description: Rooted in India's rich stone heritage, we blend traditional craftsmanship with contemporary design to create globally admired marble and granite solutions.
